plcNodes.description:
Define product type, ingredients, processing method, packaging, labeling, and production capacity.

Key requirements: Product category, ingredients, production flow, and capacity

Validation note: Different food categories may trigger different EFDA/AAFDA requirements.

plcNodes.name: Fit out food processing area to food safety standard
plcNodes.agency: Ethiopian Food and Drug Authority / eRIS iLicense
plcNodes.description:
Prepare production area, washing, storage, equipment, ventilation, sanitation, pest control, and waste handling.

Key requirements: Food safety premises readiness evidence

Validation note: Premises design determines inspection outcome.

plcNodes.name: Apply for food manufacturer/processor competency approval
plcNodes.agency: Ethiopian Food and Drug Authority / eRIS iLicense
plcNodes.description:
Apply through EFDA/eRIS/iLicense or local equivalent for competency approval for food production.

Key requirements: iLicense/eRIS competency application package

Validation note: Requirements may include facility inspection and document review.

plcNodes.name: Prepare labeling, packaging, and product compliance evidence
plcNodes.agency: Ethiopian Food and Drug Authority / eRIS iLicense
plcNodes.description:
Prepare product label, packaging specifications, batch/traceability records, and food safety controls.

Key requirements: Draft product labels and packaging specifications

Validation note: Labeling/product rules must be checked for exact product type.

plcNodes.name: Publish PLC formation notice if required
plcNodes.agency: National Newspaper Publisher - To Be Verified
plcNodes.description:
Publish company formation notice if the current PLC pathway requires public notice.

Validation note: Verify whether this is still required for the exact company form.

plcNodes.name: Submit commercial registration application
plcNodes.agency: Addis Ababa City Administration Trade Bureau / Sub-city Trade Office
plcNodes.description:
Submit registration package to Addis Ababa Trade Bureau or relevant registration office.

Key requirements: TIN, name reservation, authenticated lease, and entity documents

Validation note: Incomplete document packets can force repeat visits.

plcNodes.name: Receive commercial registration certificate
plcNodes.agency: Addis Ababa City Administration Trade Bureau / Sub-city Trade Office
plcNodes.description:
Receive the certificate confirming the legal existence of the business.

Validation note: Certificate issuance depends on accepted registration package.

plcNodes.name: Apply for trade/business license
plcNodes.agency: Addis Ababa City Administration Trade Bureau / Sub-city Trade Office
plcNodes.description:
Apply for the final trade or business license using registration and competency/supporting documents.

Key requirements: Commercial registration certificate; Sector or professional Certificate of Competence

Validation note: Competency certificate and registration documents must be aligned with the business code.

plcNodes.name: Receive trade/business license
plcNodes.agency: Addis Ababa City Administration Trade Bureau / Sub-city Trade Office
plcNodes.description:
Receive the final license authorizing business operation.

Validation note: License renewal and amendments must be tracked after launch.

plcNodes.name: Unblock and activate business bank account if PLC
plcNodes.agency: Licensed Commercial Bank
plcNodes.description:
Convert the blocked account into an operating account after licensing/registration requirements are met.

Validation note: Bank may request license, registration certificate, and tax documents.

plcNodes.name: Register for VAT or TOT / confirm tax account
plcNodes.agency: Ministry of Revenues / Sub-city Tax Office
plcNodes.description:
Register or confirm the appropriate tax category and filing account with the tax authority.

Key requirements: Business license and TIN

Validation note: The correct tax path depends on turnover, sector, and current tax rules.

plcNodes.name: Set up approved receipt, invoicing, or fiscal compliance method
plcNodes.agency: Approved Fiscal Solution Vendor / e-Invoicing Provider
plcNodes.description:
Install or activate the approved receipt/invoicing/fiscal compliance method required for legal receipts.

Key requirements: Tax registration evidence and approved receipt solution

Validation note: Current fiscal/e-invoicing path should be verified for each business type.

plcNodes.name: Hire staff and issue employment contracts
plcNodes.agency: Applicant / Founders / Internal Company Action
plcNodes.description:
Hire staff and prepare written contracts, job descriptions, payroll records, and HR files.

Validation note: Can be parallel but must align with labor and pension obligations.

plcNodes.name: Register employer and employees with POESSA
plcNodes.agency: Private Organization Employees’ Social Security Agency (POESSA)
plcNodes.description:
Register the employer and eligible employees with the pension/social security system.

Validation note: Often missed until after hiring begins; verify deadline and portal path.

plcNodes.name: Begin operations and maintain compliance
plcNodes.agency: Applicant / Founders / Internal Company Action
plcNodes.description:
Begin operations and maintain license renewals, tax filings, employee obligations, and sector compliance.

Validation note: Post-launch compliance should be tracked as part of the journey, not treated as separate.

plcNodes.name: Obtain Fayda or ensure Fayda authentication is available
plcNodes.agency: National ID Program / Fayda

Secure or confirm Fayda identity/authentication readiness before using identity-linked services.

Key requirements: Fayda ID / FIN / authentication credential

Validation note: Confirm exactly where Fayda is enforced in the current service path.

plcNodes.name: Obtain TIN
plcNodes.agency: Ministry of Revenues / Sub-city Tax Office
plcNodes.description:
Register for taxpayer identification with the relevant Ministry of Revenues/sub-city tax office.

Key requirements: Personal ID/passport and biometric presence

Validation note: May require in-person presence and biometrics.

plcNodes.name: Reserve trade name
plcNodes.agency: Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration (MoTRI) / eTrade
plcNodes.description:
Reserve the proposed business name through MoTRI/eTrade or the relevant business registration service.

Key requirements: Proposed trade names

Validation note: Name conflicts or portal downtime can delay progress.

plcNodes.name: Choose legal structure
plcNodes.agency: Applicant / Founders / Internal Company Action
plcNodes.description:
Decide whether the business will operate as a sole proprietorship, PLC, or another permitted form.

Validation note: The choice changes capital, document, and liability requirements.

plcNodes.name: Draft MoA and AoA if forming a PLC
plcNodes.agency: Applicant / Founders / Internal Company Action

Validation note: PLC-only step; sole proprietor skips this.

plcNodes.name: Authenticate lease agreement
plcNodes.agency: Document Authentication and Registration Service (DARS)

Key requirements: Signed lease and landlord proof of authority

Validation note: Landlord title/authority documents may be required.

plcNodes.name: Authenticate MoA and AoA if PLC
plcNodes.agency: Document Authentication and Registration Service (DARS)
plcNodes.description:
Authenticate company constitutional documents for the PLC pathway.

Validation note: Conditional PLC step; shareholders may need to appear.

plcNodes.name: Open blocked capital account if PLC
plcNodes.agency: Licensed Commercial Bank
plcNodes.description:
Open a blocked capital account and obtain bank confirmation where required.

Validation note: Bank requirements may vary by institution.
